name: field-final-red-team-e2e-closure
objective: Close Field 3 only on the exact latest branch A candidate after final cleanup and full cross-surface/device/security/CI evidence.
truthOwner: Latest candidate implementation/runtime/repository-platform evidence; package text cannot override a failure.

tasks.objective: Run final exact-SHA closure and keep the package OPEN until every in-scope defect and duplicate is exhausted.
tasks.currentProblem: Unit-level evidence becomes stale after later writes and cannot prove integrated provider creation, Partners organization, Marketing publication, WLT settlement, device/offline behavior or final cleanup.
tasks.requiredChange: Fetch/re-pin latest A after last product write; run strict validator and all invalidated checks; execute end-to-end provider creation/activation and both onboarding origins; visit/checklist/Partners approval; catalog/Marketing publication; same store/product Partner+Client positive/negative readback; commissions/payout/offboarding; offline/restart; Android native artifact; security and applicable CI. Scan diffs/tree for duplicate/dead Field code and legacy packages, fix root causes and repeat.
tasks.targetState: All U001-U014 outcomes coexist on one SHA; every related Control Panel page/tab is coherent; app-field real Android journey passes; no Field COD/incidents/penalties or provisioning/view/package duplicates remain; applicable warnings/checks are clean; package can truthfully become CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE.
tasks.action: Use exact-SHA evidence matrix, device/runtime/database/API/UI/adversarial checks and suitable Sonar/Graphify/Trivy/contracts tools when available; intentionally test negative/race/offline/unknown-result paths; repair every root defect before final bookkeeping and PR to master.
mustNotChange: لا fake green أو ignored warning متعلق بالنطاق.
لا PR إلى master قبل closure.
acceptanceCriteria: All required checks pass on evidence compatible with the final A SHA.
Field create→activation→login works from canonical Control Panel/Workforce path.
Assignment and self-initiated onboarding both converge and Partners readiness review works.
Marketing publication and rejection/hidden negative path preserve same store/product IDs through Partner/Client.
Field finance contains no COD/incidents/penalties and payout/offboarding is WLT-governed.
Applicable CI/security/database/contracts/runtime checks have no in-scope blocker.
Final tree scan finds no known executable Field defect, duplicate or obsolete package.
tasks.rollback: Any failure returns package to OPEN and is forward-fixed; closure never rolls back to weaker behavior.
tasks.commitBoundary: Final evidence/bookkeeping only after product candidate is stable.
